notes:
CRM notes:
- Company: SMB/scale-up selling a multi-tenant helpdesk layer to e-commerce merchants.
- Use-case: replace brittle rules + regex tags with model-driven auto-tagging + one-click macro suggestions for agents. Goal: 30% reduction in tag-misclassification, 20% faster TTR.
- Workload shape: mostly short emails (1-6 sentences) + attached order IDs; periodic marketing spikes (campaign-related ticket surges up to ~900 rps burst for 10-15 min).
- Perf targets: 95th pct latency < 250ms for summarization path under normal load; degrade gracefully to async batch with webhook fallback during bursts.
- Throughput target: baseline 120 req/s steady, burst to 1000 req/s for short intervals.
- Quality bar: concise 1–2 line summary + 3 auto-suggested tags (confidence score). Must support "do not auto-tag" override and agent-edit audit trail.
- Integrations: Zendesk primary, Freshdesk secondary. Need macros export (CSV or Zendesk macro import), ability to push tags and suggested macros into ticket UI, webhook ack/resend semantics.
- Security: customer requires VPC/private control plane for POC, SOC2 + SSO (SAML) mandatory, retention controls to keep PII out of model logs. Prefer KMS integration for keys.
- Quote from Head of Support: "We need summaries that save clicks — not complicated paraphrases. If the tags are wrong, agents will turn it off"
- Cost sensitivity: willing to pay premium for reliability during spikes but wants Optimize recommendations to reduce token spend (quantization/batching suggestions).
- Decision process: technical eval -> legal/security signoff -> procurement. Buying committee: Head of Support, CTO, Platform Security, Procurement.
- POC scope items: data scrub SOP, staging Zendesk webhook, sample 20k ticket dataset, evaluation metrics (precision/recall for tags, summary brevity + agent accept rate).
- Known constraints: internal IdP change scheduled end of March — SAML binding date may shift POC start.
- Internal stakeholder note: Procurement wants fixed monthly price if Dedicated is chosen.
- Action items: SE to provide POC runbook + tokenized demo keys; AE to secure signed NDA; Infra to verify VPC peering options with RBC partner team.
requirements_summary: Need an inference solution that produces short ticket summaries and 3 high-confidence tags per ticket, pushes suggestions into Zendesk as macros/tags, supports VPC deployment for POC, meets SOC2/SAML requirements, and can stay resilient under marketing-driven spikes (burst capacity and graceful async fallback). Evaluation will measure tagging precision, summary accept rate by agents, latency at 95th percentile, and cost per ticket.
opportunity_notes: High likelihood to convert to Dedicated if POC meets SLAs. Main upsell: longer-term Dedicated + Optimize package for batch/quantization savings. Procurement asks for annual commit if SLA and price acceptable.
deal_history: First contact 2026-01 via inbound trial. AE assigned 2026-02-10. Multiple demos in Feb; now moving to POC. Legal NDA requested 2026-02-20 (pending).
internal_risks: IdP timeline, data residency wording in contract, potential sensitivity to mis-tagging leading to agent opt-out.
